visual_identity.core_identity: An oversized beetle with a heavy oval shell and prominent luminous gland structures that make it recognizable even in black-and-white line art.
visual_identity.silhouette: Low oval beetle body, domed wing cases, six stout legs, short antennae, broad head.
visual_identity.head_features: Compact insect head with mandibles, short antennae, and distinct rounded gland bulges near the head.
visual_identity.body_shape: Three-part insect body with hard domed elytra, six legs, and a compact abdomen.
visual_identity.surface: Large smooth armor plates with restrained segment lines; gland areas outlined clearly rather than shaded.
